title: Everyday Phrases — A Piano Lesson
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎹 實用「鋼琴課」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Piano Lesson
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「鋼琴課」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是琴房：每週一次的鋼琴課：進琴房先調椅子與踏板、暖手，老師指定曲目、分手慢練，卡在同一個小節就放慢再來，最後合手、記下指法與作業，約好下週時間。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'A Piano Lesson' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A weekly piano lesson: adjusting the bench, warming up, working hands separately through a stubborn bar, then putting the hands together and writing down the homework. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, Ming. Are you ready?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm ready for class.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's it like outside now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The street is very wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, do you have your music book?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ duː juː hæv jʊr ˈmjuːzɪk bʊk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's right here in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is our room today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are in room five today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I put my bag here?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把袋子放這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the chair is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is our piano teacher?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miss Lin teaches every Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will she come here soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is walking down the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we open the window?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room feels warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which piano is the right one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the only one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, Ming. Sorry I'm late.
dialogue.zh: 小明你好。抱歉我遲到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's okay, I just arrived.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your hands clean?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I washed them already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, do you like this chair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it feels too low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I make it higher?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please turn the knob.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this height suit me now?
dialogue.zh: 這樣的高度現在適合我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, my arms feel free.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，我的手臂很放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I put my feet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them on the pedal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should the pedal sit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My right foot reaches it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sit closer to the piano?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ sɪt ˈkloʊsər tu ðə piˈæno?/
dialogue.zh: 我該坐靠近鋼琴一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the chair forward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How straight is my back now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, lift your shoulders a bit.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，肩膀再抬高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we warm up first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold hands play very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we warm up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only about five minutes today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want me to stretch now?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː juː wɑnt miː tuː strɛtʃ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你要我現在伸展一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it very gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my hands still cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they feel warm now.
dialogue.zh: 不會，現在摸起來是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we start with a scale?
dialogue.zh: 我們先從音階開始好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: C major is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times should I play it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni taɪmz ʃʊd aɪ ple ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Play it four times, then stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that scale too fast?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, keep it steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which hand should I use first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with your right hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my thumb on C?
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指在 C 的哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the first finger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I count the notes out loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kaʊnt ðə noʊts aʊt laʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Counting helps you stay steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my fingers too flat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, curve them a little.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，讓它們稍微彎曲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my wrist be high?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it level with your arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ɪt ˈlɛvəl wɪð jʊr ɑrm/
dialogue.zh: 不用，和手臂保持同高就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my elbows stay close?
dialogue.zh: 我的手肘要靠近身體嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but not too close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which finger plays the last note?
dialogue.zh: 最後一個音用哪一指彈？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little finger plays it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my left hand start lower?
dialogue.zh: 我的左手要從更低的地方開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One octave below.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my little finger is weak?
dialogue.zh: 也許我的小指比較沒力？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press a little harder there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I lift my fingers high?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep them near the keys.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my shoulders too tight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drop them and breathe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I play the scale again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以再彈一次音階嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slower this time, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the ending any better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your last notes were clear.
dialogue.zh: 有，你最後幾個音很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use the metronome now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, just play freely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How slow should this scale be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow enough to hear each note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, do my fingers look curved enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ du maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz lʊk kɜrvd ɪˈnʌf?/
dialogue.zh: 我的手指看起來夠彎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that shape is very good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, do we play the hands apart?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ duː wiː pleɪ ðə hændz əˈpɑrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the best way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part sounds wrong to you?
dialogue.zh: 你覺得哪個部分聽起來不對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The third line sounds uneven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could we try it once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, take a deep breath.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my counting sound steady now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在的拍子聽起來穩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You kept a nice tempo.
dialogue.zh: 穩定，你保持了很好的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we always warm up this long?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈɔlweɪz wɔrm ʌp ðɪs lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們每次都要暖手這麼久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only on cold days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I drink some water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a cup on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my seat be higher?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this height looks right.
dialogue.zh: 不會，這個高度看起來剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want to see my notes?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː juː wɑnt tuː siː maɪ noʊts?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, we have time today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we starting the song next?
dialogue.zh: 我們接下來要開始彈曲子了 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open your book to page six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which page is today's song?
dialogue.zh: 今天這首曲子是第幾頁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page six, the short one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the song called?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's called Little Star Garden.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have I played this song before?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this one is new.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you play it for me first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju pleɪ ɪt fə miː fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, listen to the melody.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the song start slowly?
dialogue.zh: 這首曲子開頭是慢的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it starts slowly and ends softly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt stɑrts ˈsloʊli ænd ɛndz ˈsɔftli/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pages does it use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one page, very short.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this song have a sharp?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One sharp near the end.
dialogue.zh: 接近結尾有一個升記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which line should we try first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's read the top line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these notes in the bass clef?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz noʊts ɪn ðə beɪs klɛf?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your left hand plays them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, do I say the notes aloud?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl duː aɪ seɪ ðə noʊts əˈlaʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, say each note clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which note is a quarter?
dialogue.zh: 哪一個音才是四分音符？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is a quarter note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do I hold it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it for two counts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which fingers play these four notes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, then four.
dialogue.zh: 一指、二指、三指，然後四指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I write the fingering down?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把指法寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your pencil lightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my pencil now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's beside your book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we play the right hand first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ple ðə raɪt hænd fɜrst?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The melody comes first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear the melody?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very easy, it repeats twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, do I count while I play?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ duː aɪ kaʊnt waɪl aɪ pleɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count quietly in your head.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this line have any rests?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One rest in the middle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, do I lift my hand there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd duː aɪ lɪft maɪ hænd ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lift it for one beat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How slow is this tempo?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels just right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I try the first line alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃæl aɪ traɪ ðə fɜrst laɪn əˈloʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以自己試第一行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll listen from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I miss any notes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You skipped one note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which note did I skip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last note in bar four.
dialogue.zh: 第四小節的最後一個音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I play it for you again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ple ɪt fɔr ju əˈɡɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我要再彈一次給你聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the very top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we play that bar again?
dialogue.zh: 我們再彈一次那一小節好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly from the start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does bar four sound strange?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼第四小節聽起來怪怪的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your thumb lands on the wrong key.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr θʌm lændz ɑn ðə rɔŋ ki/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my third finger come early?
dialogue.zh: 我的第三指是不是進得太早？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wait for the second count.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we practice only bar four?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以只練第四小節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, let's do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times do I repeat it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni taɪmz du aɪ rɪˈpit ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Repeat it five times slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I getting any better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but it's still uneven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do I keep stopping there?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼我每次都在那裡停下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because your hand is tense.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rest my hand now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, relax it for a moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which bar is the hardest one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most students stop here.
dialogue.zh: 多數學生都在這裡卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we slow it down more?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再放慢一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, half the speed now.
dialogue.zh: 可以，現在用一半的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, do I count out loud here?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ duː aɪ kaʊnt aʊt laʊd hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could my left hand be the problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd maɪ lɛft hænd biː ðə ˈprɑbləm?/
dialogue.zh: 問題會不會出在我的左手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, so play the right hand only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi soʊ ple ðə raɪt hænd ˈoʊnli/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it sound clean now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much cleaner, keep that shape.
dialogue.zh: 乾淨多了，保持那個手形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I try both hands again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the bar sound right this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə bɑr saʊnd raɪt ðɪs taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這次小節聽起來對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one note is still late.
dialogue.zh: 差不多了，還有一個音太晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one is still late?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The note before the rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, do I hold that note longer?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ duː aɪ hoʊld ðæt noʊt ˈlɔŋɡər?/
dialogue.zh: 那個音我要按久一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just play it sooner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it sound better without pedal?
dialogue.zh: 不踩踏板聽起來會不會更好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pedal hides mistakes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I mark this bar in red?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ mɑrk ðɪs bɑr ɪn rɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用紅筆標這個小節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, circle it twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I remember this at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you practice slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to move to the next line?
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm tuː muːv tuː ðə nɛkst laɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, bar four needs work.
dialogue.zh: 還不要，第四小節還要練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe feeling stuck is normal?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, everyone feels that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you let me play once more?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju lɛt mi pleɪ wʌns mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以再彈最後一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I'll count for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that finally correct?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that was much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I always play bar four slowly?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː aɪ ˈɔlweɪz pleɪ bɑr fɔr ˈsloʊli?/
dialogue.zh: 我每次都要慢慢彈第四小節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until your hand relaxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we ready for both hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start it very slowly today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to turn the metronome on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set it to sixty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would sixty be too slow here?
dialogue.zh: 六十在這裡會不會太慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, sixty is perfect today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which click do I follow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen to the first click.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, do the hands play together here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl du ðə hændz ple təˈɡɛðər hir?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both notes sound together here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How loud is my left hand?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it much softer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soft should I play it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft enough to hear the melody.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I staying with the click?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You stayed right on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you show me bar four again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ʃoʊ mi bɑr fɔr əˈɡen?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以再示範一次第四小節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, watch my right hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is your wrist moving?
dialogue.zh: 你的手腕為什麼一直在動？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To keep the phrase smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your arm stay relaxed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that keeps the tone warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, do I copy your fingering?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the fingering in your book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which finger is number four?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four means your ring finger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I use a different finger?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not here, it breaks the flow.
dialogue.zh: 這裡不行，會打斷順暢度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How steady is the tempo still?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very steady, hold eight bars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the speed is a bit slow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə spiːd ɪz ə bɪt sloʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 這速度也許稍微慢了些？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change the setting to seventy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that be too fast for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðæt biː tuː fæst fə miː?/
dialogue.zh: 那對我來說會不會太快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you can handle seventy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I slow down at the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ sloʊ daʊn æt ði ɛnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your last bar dragged.
dialogue.zh: 有，你最後一小節拖慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I play the last bar evenly?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː aɪ pleɪ ðə læst bɑr ˈiːvnli?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一小節我可以彈得平均嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count it out loud twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Softer at the end, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fade the ending out gently.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my hands staying together?
dialogue.zh: 我的兩手有保持在一起嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they sound much tighter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we ready for the whole page?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑː wi ˈrɛdi fə ðə hoʊl peɪdʒ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Begin slowly from the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that the best one yet?
dialogue.zh: 這是目前最好的一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you kept it steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I play it once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then we'll stop there.
dialogue.zh: 要，然後我們就停在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My left hand feels loud again.
dialogue.zh: 我的左手又覺得太大聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it sounds balanced now.
dialogue.zh: 不會，現在聽起來很平衡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you show me the middle part?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈmɪdl pɑrt?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以示範中間那段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, listen to this part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do you lift your hand there?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ju lɪft jʊr hænd ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because the phrase ends there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe a new phrase is starting?
dialogue.zh: 也許是新的樂句開始了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quieter phrase begins here.
dialogue.zh: 接著開始一段更輕的樂句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, do I breathe with the phrase?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd duː aɪ briːð wɪð ðə freɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes it flow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should this note be short?
dialogue.zh: 這張紙條該寫短一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, play it quick and light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the pedal go down here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the pedal after each note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, do I change the pedal often?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ duː aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈpɛdəl ˈɔfən?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Change it every two bars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my foot is making noise?
dialogue.zh: 也許我的腳正在發出聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, press more quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you play that section faster?
dialogue.zh: 你可以把那段彈快一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, this is the real speed.
dialogue.zh: 可以，這才是真正的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That speed looks too hard for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt spid lʊks tu hɑrd fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 那個速度對我來說太難了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, but you'll get there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which finger leads the fast part?
dialogue.zh: 快的那段由哪一指帶頭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second finger leads it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write that number down?
dialogue.zh: 我該把那個數字寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it beside the third bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my pencil mark look too dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz maɪ ˈpɛnsəl mɑrk lʊk tuː dɑrk?/
dialogue.zh: 我的鉛筆記號看起來太深嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, but it's fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we practicing the middle slowly?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以慢慢練中間那段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take four bars at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I press the keys too hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /duː aɪ prɛs ðə kiːz tuː hɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use less finger weight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the melody need more sound?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let it sing clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are my notes all the same volume?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr maɪ noʊts ɔl ðə seɪm ˈvɑljum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a little shape to them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the loudest note?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right on the long note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is humming along with it all right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈhʌmɪŋ əˈlɔŋ wɪð ɪt ɔːl raɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, humming helps your ear.
dialogue.zh: 可以，哼唱對聽力有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is recording this on my phone okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz rɪˈkɔːdɪŋ ðɪs ɒn maɪ foʊn oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用手機錄下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then listen at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you play it once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This time play it very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my tempo match yours now?
dialogue.zh: 我的速度現在跟你一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we're together at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time for the whole song again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from the beginning please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the middle part better now?
dialogue.zh: 中間那段現在好一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, it sounds smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we stopping soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes are left today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to go over things again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will go over the hard parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl ɡoʊ ˈoʊvər ðə hɑrd pɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 我們會把難的地方看一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part should I remember most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bar four is the important one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, do I keep counting out loud?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ duː aɪ kiːp ˈkaʊntɪŋ aʊt laʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least for one week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What speed should I practice at?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it at sixty for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would seventy be too fast at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ˈsɛvənti biː tuː fæst ət hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 在家用七十會不會太快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty stays safer this week.
dialogue.zh: 這星期維持六十比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should I practice daily?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes every evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, do I practice the scale too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl duː aɪ ˈpræktɪs ðə skeɪl tuː?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes before the song.
dialogue.zh: 要，彈曲子前先練五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to use the metronome?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu juz ðə ˈmɛtrənoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps your counting honest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I make the same mistake?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ meɪk ðə seɪm mɪˈsteɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我又犯同樣的錯呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then slow down and repeat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, do I write my times down?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ duː aɪ raɪt maɪ taɪmz daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把練習時間記下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the small notebook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this week's homework need one song?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs wiːks ˈhəʊmwɜːk niːd wʌn sɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 這週的作業只需要一首曲子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the C scale too.
dialogue.zh: 再加上 C 大調音階。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I learn the next page alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ lɜrn ðə nɛkst peɪdʒ əˈloʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以自己先學下一頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, wait until next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will we start the next song then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl wi stɑrt ðə nɛkst sɔŋ ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們到時候會開始下一首嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if this one is solid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Tuesday is still our time?
dialogue.zh: 下星期二還是我們的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time, four o'clock again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to come a little early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes early is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to bring anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu brɪŋ ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls?/
dialogue.zh: 我還需要帶別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your book and pencil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe my book is getting too messy?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi maɪ bʊk ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ tuː ˈmɛsi?/
dialogue.zh: 也許我的譜變得 太亂了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, erase the old marks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And, do I keep the fingering numbers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd duː aɪ kiːp ðə ˈfɪŋɡərɪŋ ˈnʌmbərz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are very useful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was today's biggest problem?
dialogue.zh: 今天最大的問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your hand got tense again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How can I fix that at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ kæn aɪ fɪks ðæt æt hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax your arm before each bar.
dialogue.zh: 每一小節前先放鬆手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it be easier next week?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, next week will be easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you happy with my progress?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your playing improved a lot today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will we end with the whole song?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl wi ɛnd wɪð ðə hoʊl sɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用整首曲子作結嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, play it one final time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was that for a finish?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very nice, you should be proud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the second page wait three weeks?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈsɛkənd peɪdʒ weɪt θri wikz/
dialogue.zh: 第二頁要等三個星期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, after the next one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to close the piano lid?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then cover all the keys.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the room light is still on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə ruːm laɪt ɪz stɪl ɒn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, turn it off please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, do I put the chair back?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ duː aɪ pʊt ðə tʃɛr bæk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push it under the piano.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I leave my book?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it home with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I leave anything on the chair?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ liv ˈɛniθɪŋ ɑn ðə tʃɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我有東西留在椅子上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your pencil stayed on the chair.
dialogue.zh: 你的鉛筆還留在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the window close all the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ kloʊz ɔːl ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the rain has stopped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell Mom about bar four?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛl mɑm əˈbaʊt bɑr fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我該跟媽媽說第四小節的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she can remind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you check my notebook next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju tʃɛk maɪ ˈnoʊtbʊk nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 你下次會看我的筆記本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it every single Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would twenty minutes be enough today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if you focus fully.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I practice in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, any quiet time works.
dialogue.zh: 可以，任何安靜的時間都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my hands feel tired?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest them for a minute.
dialogue.zh: 那就讓它們休息一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I play the scale every day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ple ðə skeɪl ˈɛvri deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That warms up your cold fingers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I play it next week?
dialogue.zh: 我下星期就彈得起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty will work for sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you play it with me then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju ple ɪt wɪð mi ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 到時候你會跟我一起彈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll play the left hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What concert is coming up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spring concert, in May.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to play in it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tu ple ɪn ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only if you want.
dialogue.zh: 不一定，只有你想彈才彈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you be there with me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I sit in front.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would playing for people be scary?
dialogue.zh: 彈給別人聽會很可怕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but it gets easier.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但會越來越容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I think about it first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tell me next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, do I keep the red circles?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ duː aɪ kiːp ðə rɛd ˈsɜrkəlz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They mark your trouble spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will we fix bar four next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl wi fɪks bɑr fɔr nɛkst taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我們下次會解決第四小節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That becomes our first job.
dialogue.zh: 那會是我們的第一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that mean I did well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you did very well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I see you next Tuesday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four o'clock in room five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to wipe the keys now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, gently along each key.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the lamp go off now?
dialogue.zh: 現在可以把台燈關掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we're all finished here.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們這裡都結束了。

issues.note: a 問「Which bar is the hardest one?」，b 答「Most students stop here.」未點名全篇固定事實 bar four；需靠 147/152–157 的上下文才讀得通，屬迴避型接話，非 error 級。
a 問「Could I play it next week?」，b 答「Sixty will work for sure.」回的是速度而非檔期，答非所問；有實詞，故不列 error。
a 問「Where should the pedal sit?」，b 以第一人稱「My right foot reaches it.」回應，未給位置（宜作 Under your right foot.）；同型弱答另有 053、141。
「Does the second page wait three weeks? / Yes, after the next one.」與 323–325「下週即可碰下一首」節奏略有張力，三週之說無來由，屬輕微接續模糊。
a 問「Would twenty minutes be enough today?」，但 299 已言「Ten minutes are left today.」；可解讀為每日練習量，惟字面上與當日剩餘時間相衝，屬輕微。
段 3、段 4 的 b 句 Yes/No 起句已由 68%/60% 降至約 28%/32%，稀釋確實生效；殘留為第四小節與節拍器練習迴圈中同型問答連續多對（教學情境下屬合理反覆，非缺陷）。

review.summary_zh: 本輪「應答節拍稀釋」在最新視圖中確實落實：段 3（200–299）b 句 Yes/No 起句約 28%、段 4（300–399）約 32%（純 Yes 起句為 22%/28%），較先前 68%/60% 明顯下降，且無空心回應、無 WH 問句被 Yes-No 回答、固定設定（Miss Lin、Ming、room five、週二四點、bar four 最難、page six、暖手五分鐘、每日二十分鐘）前後一致、結尾收束，故 APPROVED。殘留僅為個別答非所問／答非所位（167、375、31、349、367）之輕微瑕疵；IPA 維度依機器證據（hard=0、SUSPECT 0、逐詞對齊通過）給滿分。
